package.name: matrix_navigation
package.description: M.A.T.R.I.X Member 4 (Hybrid A* global planner + DWA local planner) and Member 5 (CBF safety filter) -- first working implementation, authored for this integration since no prior implementation existed. Receding-horizon Hybrid A* over Member-2's real local costmap (no persistent global map/SLAM exists in this stack), real DWA velocity sampling, and a simplified single-constraint analytic CBF.
